announcements.headline: Uranium readings up to 0.42% U₃O₈ at Charlot-Neely
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals reports uranium readings at Charlot-Neely, following earlier identification of targets there. This confirms progress in exploration activities previously announced.

announcements.headline: Publication of Updated Investor Presentation
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals publishes an updated investor presentation to consolidate recent exploration progress at Charlot-Neely and Fontaine Lake.

announcements.headline: New critical mineral recoveries expand potential
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals reports new critical mineral recoveries following its pilot site agreement and uranium target identifications in October and November. This suggests technical progress at its Charlot-Neely and Fontaine Lake sites.

announcements.headline: Fulcrum to increase shareholding in Loyalist
announcements.insight: Fulcrum increases its stake in Loyalist, following earlier uranium target identifications. This signals continued commitment to developing its identified resource zones.

announcements.headline: Eight uranium zones identified at Fontaine Lake
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals identifies eight uranium zones at Fontaine Lake following earlier target identification at Charlot-Neely. This expands the exploration programme initiated in August.

announcements.headline: Uranium targets identified at Charlot-Neely
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals identifies uranium targets at Charlot-Neely, advancing its exploration programme commenced in August following the secured pilot facility support.

announcements.headline: Secures £1m support for pilot facility development
announcements.insight: Securing pilot facility support follows the August option amendment and October agreement. This advances exploration activities but lacks financial detail for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Pilot site & Pilot Technology Agreement Secured
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals secures a pilot site and technology agreement, following its August exploration programme commencement. This operational step advances its Saskatchewan uranium option.

announcements.headline: Fulcrum starts trading on OTCQB Venture Market
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals shares begin trading on the OTCQB Venture Market. This follows recent exploration and resource updates.

announcements.headline: Commencement of Exploration Programme
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals begins exploration following the July resource update. This advances the Big Bear Project but lacks financial details.

announcements.headline: Amendment to Saskatchewan uranium option agreement
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals amended its Saskatchewan uranium option agreement following earlier project updates. Shareholders should monitor subsequent developments regarding this asset.

announcements.headline: AGM Statement
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note this AGM follows recent operational updates including soil sampling, a pilot plant agreement, and an updated resource estimate.

announcements.headline: Updated Tully Gold Resource
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals updates its Tully Gold Resource following earlier soil sampling and pilot plant deployment. This suggests continued technical evaluation of project assets.

announcements.headline: Pilot Plant Deployment Agreement Signed
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals signed a Pilot Plant Deployment Agreement following June soil sampling. This marks progression from exploration to testing at the Big Bear Project.

announcements.headline: Soil sampling results from Big Bear Project
announcements.insight: Fulcrum Metals reports soil sampling results from its Big Bear Project. Shareholders should monitor subsequent exploration updates to assess resource potential.
